This '''battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and participated in the [[Battle of Kiros]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the Battle of Kiros, this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], along with two others and a group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] was guarding a [[Thermal annihilator bomb/Legends|thermal annihilator bomb]], under command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed along with all the others when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] attacked them on [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]] and deactivated the [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]], the actor who voices all the battle droids in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].
